title: phase-lattice harness records a tie
decision: Keep the Stage-1 question (fixed coupled-line reservoir vs raw waveform, same linear readout); the run's own next move names temporal XOR or richer coupling.

evidence.conditions: run 20260611-004418, tile_8x64_slow, 8 wires x 64 slots = 512 features, single seed 1234, PyTorch 2.2

title: Rebuilt as Delay Tensor
decision: Clean-room rebuild on NumPy and scikit-learn after finding three archive bugs (0.01-scale masks made modulation a no-op, second_neighbour_strength never read, no gradient ever reached the reservoir); 3 seeds, identical readout across arms, typed config, static SVG reports.

evidence.metric: temporal XOR accuracy, raw vs reservoir
evidence.conditions: tensor_8x64, seeds 1234-1236, stratified 25% hold-out, LogisticRegression C=1; reproduced digit for digit on 2026-11-04

title: SPICE equivalence bench
decision: Check the update equations against ngspice by unrolling each slot into a stage; confine GPL-3.0 PySpice to benches/.

evidence.conditions: 8x64 config, noise off, batch 4 = 2,048 stages, one .op solve; proves the translation of the equations, nothing about hardware; caught a wrong tanh gating in the netlist while being written

date_note: Undated in the records; uncommitted work after 2026-10-10, present in the 2026-11-04 working tree.
title: RF benches and extraction plumbing
decision: Build the real lines the recurrence stands in for (mcl bus, microstrip pair, LC ladder) and an ERA/Ho-Kalman extractor so an extracted line can replace the recurrence.

evidence.value: 1.1e-11 to 4.5e-13; ladder within ~1% of distributed line
evidence.conditions: 10 MHz-3 GHz, loss linearised at 1 GHz; no end-to-end run feeds an extracted line into classification

title: First MNIST run
decision: Record the result as inside run-to-run noise; nothing established.

evidence.metric: MNIST accuracy, tensor features vs raw pixels (linear)
evidence.conditions: run 20261104-144850, mnist_8x784 (6,272 features), canonical 60k/10k split, 3 seeds, streaming SGD readout, 8 GB machine, 19.8 min

title: Ablation: the XOR win belongs to tanh
decision: Read the XOR result as a property of the per-slot nonlinearity, not of coupling or memory; a jittered-pulse XOR is named as the test of what coupling is for (not run).

evidence.metric: XOR reservoir accuracy under one-knob ablations
evidence.value: no coupling 1.000 +/- 0.000; decay 0.5 1.000; identity instead of tanh 0.531 +/- 0.196
evidence.conditions: one change from tensor_8x64 per run, seeds 1234-1236; run for the Crosstalk write-up, not part of the project's own results; after DLNN phase 1

title: DLNN planned: ternary taps on coax, four tiers
decision: Ternary tapped-delay-line convolution (TDL-Net-S, dilations 1/4/16) on RG-58 at a 10 ns symbol, evaluated at tiers V, E, C, R; supersedes a discarded 433 MHz OOK-receiver plan.

evidence.value: 1,216 ternary weights
evidence.conditions: 8-class synthetic modulation recognition, 16,000 train / 4,000 test, SNR 0-20 dB; not comparable with RadioML

title: Width 8 misses target; width 32 headline
decision: Replace the plan's underfitting recipe and make the width-32 net the headline; keep width 8 reported as secondary.

evidence.conditions: test set, 4,000 examples; w32 single seed; seeds picked on train accuracy

title: E tier RTL bit-exact
decision: Accept the 8-bit fixed-point tier as matching V; status ok requires zero RTL mismatches.

evidence.metric: RTL vs numpy golden model mismatches
evidence.value: 0 of 202,752 chained layer values (w32); 0 of 198,144 (w8); E vs V top-1 agreement 0.9972
evidence.conditions: Icarus Verilog 12 on 64 test examples; w32 check covers first 32 of 128 steps, w8 all 128; 4,000-example metrics run on the golden model

title: Coax cascade; gain rule explains most of C's gap; coax not buildable
decision: Keep the default per-layer trim and published numbers, but read them as over-driven layer 3 at an unbuildable no-repeater point; drop coax.

evidence.metric: C tier accuracy at 32 dB/us by loss-compensation mode
evidence.conditions: final-w32, 4,000 examples, --cascade, RG-58 32 dB/us, no repeaters, up to 1.12 us per tap; layer-3 saturation 72.4% vs 49.5% in V (400 examples)

title: LLM commentary demoted
decision: Move the LLM out of the default pipeline into an appendix: it restates the card and does not discover.

evidence.value: 0 of 5 without the Python-computed list (5 of 5 with it); 1 of 3 controls correct
evidence.conditions: Qwen2.5-1.5B Q4_K_M on synthetic cards; BitNet b1.58-2B degenerate output

title: Phase 2 planned: LC-ladder TILE-8
decision: Lumped LC-ladder lines on one tile design for every layer, 0402 resistor crossbar (the CPL is the model), BJT diff-pair tanh, S/H re-timing, NUCLEO-G474RE; d = 1 and retrain; designed, not built.

evidence.value: 56 sections x (120 uH, 120 pF), Z0 1 kohm, 120 ns per section, tap every 8 sections
evidence.conditions: plan values; stripline, BBD, op-amp all-pass, SAW and single-loop options rejected

title: TILE-8 electrical design (M1a)
decision: Choose FHW1812IF121JST (unshielded, Q-min 10); input RC 1.5 MHz -> 482 kHz; half-value end capacitors; current-mirror diff-pair tail; 125 kBd.

evidence.value: ripple 93% -> 29% peak to peak; ringing 13.7% -> 2.8% (Q 30), 23% -> 8.8% (lossless)
evidence.conditions: ngspice 42 with datasheet-derived models; Q 30 assumed; loss 2.26 dB at 250 kHz at Q-min

date_note: Phase 2 milestone; records date the phase 2 plan 2026-11-03 and the commit 2026-11-04, nothing finer.
title: Retrained at d = 1; arena
decision: Accept TDL-Net-B w8 d = 1 as the board network; fallbacks not trained.

evidence.value: 0.8055 / 0.8375 (gate 0.70 / 0.75); float CNN 0.9093, cumulant 0.8745, float-readout DLNN 0.8512
evidence.conditions: 3 seeds selected on train accuracy; same 16,000/4,000 synthetic set for all models

date_note: Phase 2 milestone; not dated finer than 2026-11-03 to 2026-11-04.
title: Board-aware training and the QPSK collapse fix
decision: Select on the worst class (every class >= 0.35 on validation on both Q corners) and train the ternary readout with focal loss; ship the float-readout aware2_fro as board default.

evidence.metric: accuracy on the M1a Q = 10 line; QPSK recall
evidence.value: collapsed aware2 0.797 with QPSK 0.000; aware2_fro 0.878 with QPSK 0.690 (ternary-readout focal 0.812)
evidence.conditions: ngspice FIR of the M1a ladder, Q 10/30 mix, +/-14% per-tap delay jitter in training; 3 seeds per variant, one dataset; board-only nets (ideal line 0.655-0.675)

date_note: Phase 2 milestone; not dated finer than 2026-11-03 to 2026-11-04.
title: MLP strawman corrected
decision: Retune the raw-I/Q MLPs with a validation split and add phase-invariant feature MLPs as separate rows.

evidence.conditions: grid search on train[:14000], validation train[14000:], refit 3 seeds; grid optima partly on the edge

date_note: Phase 2 milestone (P2-M2a, P2-M2b); not dated finer than 2026-11-03 to 2026-11-04.
title: P tier and the gain-trim bug
decision: Report finding F1 as a design bug: feedback, bias and output resistors about 2.9x larger (ECO-2), plus terminating lines to VREF25 (ECO-1); neither is yet in the drawn board.

evidence.value: 0.168 as designed; 0.8705 (Q 10) / 0.8722 (Q 30) with 8.98 dB trim; P - V(FIR) -0.75 pt, top-1 agreement 0.948; C board mode 0.8505 / 0.8588
evidence.conditions: model aware2_fro, 4,000 examples; trim sweep 0/6/8/10 dB -> 0.18/0.46/0.84/0.83; C via calibrated model, SPICE on 64/16 examples per layer

date_note: Phase 2 milestone (P2-M2b); not dated finer than 2026-11-03 to 2026-11-04.
title: Monte Carlo and crosstalk sweeps
decision: Treat datasheet tolerances and dipole-estimated inductor crosstalk as harmless at this size; keep 4.2 mm pitch and orthogonal axes in layout anyway.

evidence.value: 1,000 boards: mean 0.8564, sigma 0.0056, min 0.8413; crosstalk arrangements 0.849-0.859 vs nominal 0.850
evidence.conditions: 800-example stratified subset for MC (L/C 5%, R 1%, clock 0.5%, V_BE 2 mV, phase 6 ns); 1,000-example subset for sweeps, ~1.1 pt standard error; k = 0.027 dipole estimate, not a field solve

date_note: Phase 2 milestone (M3b); not dated finer than 2026-11-03 to 2026-11-04.
title: Boards generated, partly routed
decision: Take the cut line: route the carrier and a 2-line layer-1 slice; leave full layer-2 and layer-3 tiles placed but unrouted.

evidence.metric: KiCad 9 DRC violations; CPL vs non-zero weights
evidence.value: 0 violations on carrier and layer-1 slice; CPL = model 85/85, 315/315, 316/316
evidence.conditions: ERC 0/0 on all variants; freerouting fanout on full layer 2 stopped after 17 min without a pass; not fabricated

title: DLNN committed; status recorded
decision: Commit and merge DLNN (sims, board, article, notebooks); status stays designed, not fabricated, nothing measured.

evidence.value: w32 virtual ternary 0.931 vs float 0.929; 52 tiles, 21,952 inductors, ~$4,135
evidence.conditions: pending: E tier on the d = 1 board net, full-tile SPICE over the test set, ECO-1/ECO-2 in the drawn board, routing layers 2-3, any measurement (Q(f) of real inductors first)
